text: dsh-bilibili（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：分析哔哩哔哩视频并生成可读摘要。它向 DSH 注册视频提取、账号登录和环境检查工具；可获取元数据、字幕或语音转写、热门评论与弹幕，并按需下载视频、定位关键帧及生成画面描述。用户可先读文稿，再指定时间点抓帧。适合研究教程、演讲或其他 B 站视频。需要 Node.js 和 FFmpeg；无字幕转写可选必剪服务或本地 ASR，视觉描述可选本地或兼容 API 的视觉模型。

dsh-bilibili is a DSH web plugin for analyzing Bilibili videos. It retrieves metadata, transcripts, comments, and danmaku, and captures frames at requested timestamps. Optional ASR transcribes videos without subtitles; optional vision models describe frames. Requires Node.js and FFmpeg.

dsh-bilibili 的功能「视频内容提取」：调用 bilibili_extract 并传入 B 站链接或 BV 号，返回视频元数据、字幕文稿、热门评论和弹幕摘要。
dsh-bilibili 的功能「无字幕转写」：没有字幕轨时可调用必剪 ASR，也可配置 sherpa-onnx 或 whisper.cpp 本地转写；结果带时间戳。
dsh-bilibili 的功能「定向关键帧」：首次读取文稿后，可用 timestamps 指定视频时间点；插件用 FFmpeg 抓帧并附上邻近字幕。
dsh-bilibili 的功能「画面描述」：启用视觉服务后，插件把已抓取帧交给配置的视觉模型，返回文字描述和是否适合引用的提示。
dsh-bilibili 的功能「B 站扫码登录」：通过 bilibili_login 开始二维码登录、轮询状态、查看凭证或退出；成功后保存本地凭证供后续提取使用。
dsh-bilibili 的功能「环境体检」：bilibili_doctor 检查本地依赖、配置和服务连通性；可用 refresh=true 强制重新检查。
dsh-bilibili 使用前须知：提取会访问 Bilibili API 与视频服务；无字幕时默认将音频流地址提交必剪 ASR。
dsh-bilibili 使用前须知：开启视觉描述后，抓取的帧图会发送到所配置的视觉服务；默认关闭该功能。
dsh-bilibili 使用前须知：登录凭证保存在插件目录的本地文件，读取和保存均由登录模块处理。

A DeepSeek Harness tool plugin that gives agents a `bilibili_extract` tool. Send a Bilibili link and the agent extracts the video's text information (transcript / comments / danmaku), captures keyframes on demand, and produces a summary.

> This plugin bundles no third-party binaries or models; the open-source projects and services it invokes are listed in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

---

dsh-bilibili README · 🚀 Installation：Prerequisites: Node 18+, `ffmpeg` on PATH, `pnpm`.

**Compatibility**: DeepSeek Harness `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.3.0` (declared as `engines.dsh`). DSH checks this range at install time and at profile startup; a plugin whose range does not cover the running DSH is refused or silently skipped, so v0.7.x and earlier no longer load on DSH 0.2.x — upgrade to v0.8.0+.

```sh
dsh-bilibili README · Option 1: install from GitHub (recommended)：dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/CZX2244/dsh-bilibili
dsh-bilibili README · Option 2: local directory (development; link mode applies changes instantly)：dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-bilibili

text: dsh-bilibili README · 🩺 Environment check (first-run probe)：Before the first extraction the plugin runs a **three-layer environment probe** automatically; the report is cached for about an hour (invalidated when relevant config changes). It reports only what is missing, so nothing gets installed twice and no bandwidth is wasted:

dsh-bilibili README · 🩺 Environment check (first-run probe)：| Layer | Checks | Behavior on failure |
|---|---|---|
| Local dependencies | ffmpeg / whisper-cli / sherpa-onnx binaries, model and tokens files, vision endpoint, output dir writability | **ffmpeg missing → video download and frame capture are skipped** (no more 800 MB download before a raw spawn error); a not-ready local ASR engine is skipped **before** downloading the audio stream |
| Config | `asrProvider` validity, sherpa/whisper required fields, visionBaseUrl resolution | Invalid/missing items are marked `error`/`warn` with fix hints |
| Cloud | Bilibili main API, Bijian ASR, login service reachability; SESSDATA validity (verified via nav `isLogin`, not just file existence) | Unreachable/expired items are marked `unreachable`/`warn`; an unreachable Bilibili main API is flagged as "plugin unusable" (local ASR engines get their audio stream from playurl too) |

dsh-bilibili README · 🎨 Custom output templates：The output format is a **replaceable part** of the plugin: the tool provides the data (transcript / frames / danmaku / comments), the template decides what it looks like.

dsh-bilibili README · 🎨 Custom output templates：For richer output formats (study notes, review tables, timelines, Q&A cards, etc.), install the companion skill `bilibili-video-analyzer` (an A–K format catalog) and the agent picks by user intent.

dsh-bilibili README · 🧠 Recommended workflow (two-pass; prompt-driven is the primary path)：**Frame selection is not keyword guessing** — the main agent uses the analysis prompts injected into the system prompt to read the transcript and decide **which moments are incomplete without the picture**. The built-in "content-completeness check" teaches the agent five gap types — **dangling reference / conclusion without data / unspoken operations / silent demos / visual comparisons** — and asks it to report them explicitly:
section: 🧠 Recommended workflow (two-pass; prompt-driven is the primary path)

text:
dsh-bilibili README · 🧠 Recommended workflow (two-pass; prompt-driven is the primary path)：```
① bilibili_extract(url, extract_frames: false)      # text only: instant, zero download
② the agent scans the transcript for information gaps and picks the moments that need visuals
③ the agent lists them as [建议抓帧] mm:ss reason, then calls again with timestamps —
   the plugin aligns each moment to the most changed frame within ±4s (FFmpeg scene detection),
section: 🧠 Recommended workflow (two-pass; prompt-driven is the primary path)

text: dsh-bilibili README · 🧠 Recommended workflow (two-pass; prompt-driven is the primary path)：> Fallback: only a **single call** (no `timestamps`) uses automatic selection — purely picture-driven: scene changes (sampled pass beyond 20 min), picked one per equal time bucket so a cut-heavy intro cannot take every slot, then the largest remaining gaps are backfilled. That's insurance for "the model skipped the two-pass flow", with no keyword guessing.

dsh-bilibili README · 🧠 Recommended workflow (two-pass; prompt-driven is the primary path)：> Precision note: captured frame times may differ from the requested time by up to about ±0.5s (fast seek depends on keyframe spacing), and more after scene alignment and sharp-frame refinement — the exact requested moment is shown per frame as `原始请求` in the report.

dsh-bilibili README · Local ASR transcription (optional; sherpa-onnx recommended for Chinese)：No-subtitle videos default to Bijian (zero config, anonymous, China-friendly). To go fully offline or when Bijian fails, switch to a local engine. **The plugin ships no models — only the interface; models and binaries are downloaded by the user** (no API keys, quotas, or fees involved).
section: Local ASR transcription (optional; sherpa-onnx recommended for Chinese)

text:
dsh-bilibili README · Recommended: sherpa-onnx (Chinese, SenseVoice)：Bilibili is mostly Chinese content, and SenseVoice beats Whisper on Chinese accuracy while being faster and smaller; official models are hosted on ModelScope (fast in China).

| Tier | Recommended model | Size (approx) | For |
|------|-------------------|---------------|-----|
| Low | SenseVoiceSmall (int8) | ~230 MB | low-end machines |
| Mid | SenseVoiceSmall (fp32) | ~900 MB | mainstream (recommended) |
| High | Paraformer-large | ~2.5 GB | high-end / maximum accuracy |

Steps:

dsh-bilibili README · Alternative: whisper.cpp (general / English)：| Tier | whisperModel | Model file | Size | For |
|------|--------------|------------|------|-----|
| Low | `small` | `ggml-small.bin` | ~466 MB | low-end / fast drafts |
| Mid | `medium` | `ggml-medium.bin` | ~1.5 GB | mainstream |
| High | `large-v3` | `ggml-large-v3.bin` | ~3 GB | high-end |

dsh-bilibili README · Alternative: whisper.cpp (general / English)：> Note: `asrProvider: 'auto'` falls back in order Bijian → sherpa-onnx → whisper-local. For Chinese, use at least `medium` (whisper) or pick SenseVoice (sherpa) directly. The plugin calls `sherpa-onnx-offline` with `--sense-voice-model` / `--paraformer` / `--zipformer-ctc-model` (by `sherpaModelType`), splits the audio into 30-second 16 kHz WAV chunks (non-streaming models do poorly on long audio in one piece), and parses the per-chunk JSON results from stdout; whisper-cli is called with `-oj -of` and its JSON output file is read.

dsh-bilibili README · 🔍 Frame vision descriptions (optional)：When the main model has no vision, enable this feature: each captured frame is sent to a **vision model** and returned with a `description` field, so the main model can decide **which images to cite in the report** — cite only when visual confirmation matters (charts / UIs / demo details); pure talking-head frames are not cited. Off by default; a vision failure never breaks the main flow (frame paths are still returned).

dsh-bilibili README · 🔍 Frame vision descriptions (optional)：**Local (recommended)**: install [Ollama](https://ollama.com) and pull a model — no keys, offline, free:

| Tier | visionModel | Ollama model | RAM (approx) | For |
|------|-------------|--------------|--------------|-----|
| Low | `low` | `qwen3-vl:2b` | ~2 GB | ultra low-end |
| Mid | `medium` (default) | `qwen3-vl:4b` | ~4 GB | low-end to mainstream (recommended) |
| High | `high` | `qwen3-vl:8b` | ~6-8 GB | mainstream, best quality |

dsh-bilibili README · 🔍 Frame vision descriptions (optional)：Larger models can be passed as explicit names (e.g. `qwen3-vl:32b`) — they are just no longer a default tier.

Mid-tier alternative **MiniCPM-V 4.0** (OpenBMB, 2026; officially claims to surpass GPT-4.1-mini, runs on phones; official GGUF/int4 releases — check the official library for its Ollama tag). `visionModel` also accepts explicit model names (Ollama tags or cloud model ids).

dsh-bilibili README · 🔍 Frame vision descriptions (optional)：**Other non-Qwen models (verified on the Ollama library, 2026-08)**: `minicpm-v:8b` (OpenBMB MiniCPM-V 2.6, strong Chinese OCR), `moondream` (1.9B, English-first), `gemma3n` (Google, English-first). **Kimi-VL / InternVL / GLM-4V are not in the official Ollama library** — use community GGUFs via llama.cpp or cloud OpenAI-compatible APIs (e.g. Moonshot / Zhipu). MiniCPM-V 4.0's official GGUF works on the llama-cpp route.

dsh-bilibili README · 🔍 Frame vision descriptions (optional)：> Selection rationale: this task is **understanding frame content + emitting a citation hint**, not OCR transcription — the weights are on Chinese scene understanding and instruction-following, so the default tiers use the Qwen3-VL family (consistent behavior, shared prompts); MiniCPM-V 4.0 for maximum edge efficiency.

dsh-bilibili README · 🔍 Frame vision descriptions (optional)：**llama.cpp (local alternative)**: run `llama-server` with a vision GGUF (model + mmproj); it exposes an OpenAI-compatible API, and `visionModel` is simply the `--alias` you set at launch — matching the alias to a tier keyword reuses the tier config directly:

```sh
llama-server -m qwen3-vl-8b-q4_k_m.gguf --mmproj mmproj-qwen3-vl-8b.gguf --port 8080 --alias qwen3-vl:8b

dsh-bilibili README · plugin config: visionProvider: 'llama-cpp' + visionModel: 'medium'：```

The three tiers are Qwen3-VL-first: low Qwen3-VL-2B, mid Qwen3-VL-4B (default), high Qwen3-VL-8B. Verified GGUFs: official `Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B/8B-Thinking-GGUF` (with mmproj), community `unsloth/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-GGUF`, etc. If your llama.cpp build doesn't support the Qwen3-VL architecture yet, fall back to Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct-GGUF (official on ModelScope). llama.cpp also supports MiniCPM-V (incl. 4.0), InternVL, GLM-4V, LLaVA, gemma3n, moondream2, and more.

dsh-bilibili README · plugin config: visionProvider: 'llama-cpp' + visionModel: 'medium'：**Cloud**: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint via `visionProvider: 'openai-compatible'` + `visionBaseUrl` + `visionModel` + `visionApiKey`. Single-frame description doesn't need flagship multimodal models — budget tiers suffice: GLM-4V-Flash (free quota for Chinese) / GPT-4o-mini / SiliconFlow Qwen-VL.

dsh-bilibili README · plugin config: visionProvider: 'llama-cpp' + visionModel: 'medium'：**Per-model prompts**: every built-in prompt's task is **understanding the frame's content** (what's happening, what's shown) — visible text is paraphrased as key points only, never transcribed. The plugin picks prompts automatically per model (MiniCPM-V family gets a dedicated prompt, moondream2 gets English, small low-tier models get a shorter prompt); override with `visionPrompt` (global) or `visionPromptByModel` (per explicit model name or low/medium tier).

dsh-bilibili README · plugin config: visionProvider: 'llama-cpp' + visionModel: 'medium'：**Citation quality gate**: every vision description must end with a single line 「配图建议：适合/不适合」 (suitable = clear, informative, helps readers understand; unsuitable = talking head, blurry, or uninformative). Frames carry a `citation_hint` field, and reports cite **only suitable frames**, at most 1-2 per section.

dsh-bilibili README · plugin config: visionProvider: 'llama-cpp' + visionModel: 'medium'：**2B measured results** (2026-08, llama.cpp b10428 + Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct-Q4_K_M, 16-thread CPU, 7 ground-truth test images): 100% citation-tail stability; chart values (120/240/180/300) and poster numbers (32% / 5M / three rounds) matched exactly; talking-head frames correctly marked unsuitable; 4-9s per frame. The low-tier short prompt was tuned from these live runs (anti-hallucination + citation criteria).

dsh-bilibili README · plugin config: visionProvider: 'llama-cpp' + visionModel: 'medium'：> Note: describing several frames on a CPU takes tens of seconds to minutes (faster on GPU); `visionMaxFrames` caps the count.

dsh-bilibili README · 🛠️ Local development (link mode)：`dsh plugin add` installs local directories via `link:` (changes take effect immediately). Because ESM resolves dependencies by real path, the plugin directory needs a junction pointing at the profile's node_modules:

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path ".\node_modules\@deepseek-ai" `
  -Target "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\@deepseek-ai"
```

Restart the web profile after changes.
